text:
Tom Alvarez: Looping everyone — StablePath wants a concise bench summary + final price to decide. I ran the initial sims with them yesterday; need SE + pricing signoff before I send. Can we post numbers + recommended ask here?

Maya Chen: I ran three sweeps this morning against the POC config we agreed. Short summary below, full artifacts in the run link.

Maya Chen: Test matrix: sustained 200 qps (chat gen), burst 1k qps for 60s, mixed embed+chat with 30/70 ratio. Model variant: redwood-flavored 7B quant (production-serving profile). Instance pool: 4x A100-equivalent nodes (dedicated POC).

Maya Chen: Results (aggregated): p50 85ms, p95 360ms, p99 1.1s for chat tokens; embeddings p50 40ms, p95 120ms. Tail behavior during 1k burst: tail p99 spiked to ~2.4s for ~18s while autoscaler added one node. No errors/retries.

Maya Chen: Artifacts: 
```
workload:
  - name: chat_gen
    qps: 200
    duration: 30m
  - name: burst_spike
    qps: 1000
    duration: 2m
  - name: embed_mix
    qps: 50
    ratio: 30/70
concurrency_limit: 64
suffix_cache: enabled
```

Ivan Petrov: Nice. A couple notes from infra: the p99 bump during the 1k spike was due to KV cache warm-up + one slot of provisioning (we were at 3->4 nodes). If we pre-warm by keeping 1 extra warm instance p99 stays <1.3s at 1k. Also observed minor network egress queueing on node 3 for ~20s.

Tom Alvarez: Good — can you quantify the cost delta for keeping 1 warm node? StablePath is sensitive to committed price vs. pay-as-you-go.

Priya Rao: Rough numbers from the POC run: current run cost (consumption) was ~$1,100 for the 30m sustained + burst profile (includes GPU hours + infra). If we offer a 3-month reserved POC (commit 2x the steady capacity) we can discount ~28% => estimate $800/run-equivalent and lower steady monthly.

Priya Rao: Pricing proposal to send to customer (two options):
- Consumption: $0.15 per 1k chat tokens served, $0.02 per 1k embedding tokens, billing per request. Estimated monthly at their projected 2M tokens/day => ~$9k/mo.
- Reserved POC (recommended for predictable latency): 3-month commit for a dedicated pool sized for 250 qps sustained + 2x burst buffer, flat $5,750/mo (includes 24/7 warm buffer + SLA). We can include one free pre-warm day per month.

Maya Chen: For the customer note, add this operational recommendation: keep 1 warm node (autoscaler min=1 warm), enable prefix KV cache (saves ~22% token cost on repeated prompts), and batch embeddings windows of 100 to improve throughput.

Tom Alvarez: Perfect. I'm going to draft a short email with the bench bullets + the two pricing paths. Maya/Ivan — can you +1 the technical wording? Priya — confirm we can attach the $5,750 flat POC as an official offer.

Ivan Petrov: +1 on the technical wording. Suggest we include a one-paragraph explanation of why p99 can spike and how pre-warm eliminates it.

Maya Chen: +1. Also include the monitoring dashboard link and a short run playbook so their infra folks can reproduce.

Priya Rao: Confirmed — we can offer $5,750/mo for 3 months as an official POC reserved offer. I'll draft the legal-lite SOW.

ops-bot: Run artifacts uploaded: https://s3.redwood-inference.internal/poc-runs/1715054321/ (contains raw Prometheus, latency histograms, load-generator config, and flamegraphs).

Tom Alvarez: Awesome — I'll send the customer this afternoon. Draft below, feel free to edit before I hit send:  

Tom Alvarez: "Hi team — thanks for the POC time. Short summary: sustained 200 qps with p95 ~360ms, p99 ~1.1s; 1k qps burst shows temporary p99 spikes caused by cache warm-up and autoscale (we recommend 1 warm node to eliminate). Two pricing paths attached: consumption or 3-month reserved POC at $5,750/mo. Let us know which you'd prefer and we'll provision the reserved pool and run a warm day. — Tom (Redwood)"

Maya Chen: Edits: add "prefix KV cache enabled" and attach the ops-bot link.

Ivan Petrov: + add a sentence: "We can pre-warm for the first 24 hours at no charge to validate latency under your exact traffic profile."

Priya Rao: I'll attach the pricing breakout and the SOW draft.

Tom Alvarez: Thanks all. I'll send and post the thread copy here after I get their reply. :thumbsup:
